judgement_rules.background_class: v0.1 rules unchanged (no FS convention there)
judgement_rules.gain_class_feasible: D_e<=tau_D and |a-1|<=tau_A and nc_ratio<=eps_Nb and clip_frac<=tau_clip
judgement_rules.scalar_weights: R_bg weights frozen in reward_weights_contract_v0.2.json; R_gain construction proposal at gain class step 5 (dB-identity coefficients, user confirmation pending at v0.2 freeze time)

scope_limits: values are properties of the t3 development families plus the stated dispersion material assumption; not field-data thresholds
do not tighten beyond the material-assumption sensitivity (+/-3.3..6.6 dB) before the dispersion field-data study
all peak-based readouts quantised to the 0.832 ns reconstruction axis
test families {C5,C8} untouched; no solver runs; no training
gain-compensated outputs (audit_before_gain) used for the D_e battery so the fixed shared gain is not counted as damage
tau_clip is a property of the simulated_full_scale array convention (FS = max|original signature|, fixed per family); not a device ADC specification; conclusions do not extrapolate to hardware

supersedes.note: v0.1 remains valid for the background class; v0.2 adds one gain-class tolerance, reuses the rest verbatim

arrival_drift.meaning: diagnostic only; not a hard constraint at v0.1 (0.832 ns reconstruction-axis quantisation)

eps_Nb.anchor: structural floor 1.0 measured: eps x0.5 = 0.75 makes identity inadmissible (sensitivity r1); 1.5 margin admits pure gain (Nb=1.273) and excludes nc_amp +6 dB (Nb=4.96)
eps_Nb.meaning: negative-control window (250-400 ns) mean-square ratio out/in limit

tau_A.anchor: damage ladder: -1 dB rung passes (A=0.109), -3 dB rung fails (A=0.292); resolution limited by ladder spacing (+/-50% perturbation moves the rung boundary, recorded as ladder property, not refitted)

tau_D.anchor: ladder: 1-sample (0.832 ns) shift passes (D~0.86-0.89), delete fails (D=1.0); +/-50% sensitivity: zero flips both directions (robust on current evidence set)

tau_clip.anchor: metered clip ladder (0.1% rung = direct-wave neighbourhood only, 0.5% rung = record-wide headroom destruction); incumbent catalogue baselines 0.0005-0.00125 below, all mechanism-reference hard pulls >=0.0022 above; +/-50% sensitivity zero ranking effect on the current effects table; guards the future high-recovery +over-drive attack surface
tau_clip.meaning: gain-class only: full-record clipped-sample fraction (|y|>1 vs simulated_full_scale) on the operator output
